items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Well, Milton Buckner, Candy Johnson. We had a big show.

ctx.x: I went for them each year, Black and Blue and he and Jean-Pierre and Jean-Marie Manestia.
[Tom Mazia.] Who was in that band with you?

Well, Milton Buckner, Candy Johnson. We had a big show. Helen Humes was on that show. Al Casey on guitar was on that show, Ed J. McJann and his drummer, Jay McShann Guntemouth Gunther. We had Gaymouth Brown.
